description: Check Roamzy API status, including agent pause flags. Agents MUST call this before purchase attempts and back off if `purchases_paused=true`.
name: roamzy_status

anon_paused.description: When true, anonymous sessions are not being minted.

purchases_paused.description: When true, do not attempt roamzy_create_order.

reason.description: Operator note when something is paused; null otherwise.
